passages.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
passages.sermon: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God.\r\nEveryone who loves God loves those born of God.
passages.original: Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν γεννήσαντα ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν γεγεννημένον ἐξ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
passages.sermon:
We know we love the children of God by a clear sign.
We love God.
We keep God's commandments.
These actions show our love for God's children.
passages.original: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅταν τὸν Θεὸν ἀγαπῶμεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ποιῶμεν

passages.text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome, because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
passages.sermon:
God loves us.
We show love for God when we keep His commandments.
God’s commandments are not hard to obey.
Everyone born of God overcomes the world.
Our faith is the victory that overcomes the world.
passages.original: αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν καὶ αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖαι οὐκ εἰσίν ὅτι πᾶν τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ νικᾷ τὸν κόσμον καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ νίκη ἡ νικήσασα τὸν κόσμον ἡ πίστις ἡμῶν

passages.text: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
passages.sermon: The person who overcomes the world is the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.\r\nNo one else overcomes the world.\r\nOnly the believer in Jesus as God's Son has victory over the world.
passages.original: Τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ νικῶν τὸν κόσμον εἰ μὴ ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ came by water and by blood.
He did not come by water only.
He came by water and by blood.
The Holy Spirit testifies about Jesus Christ.
The Holy Spirit is the truth.
passages.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἐλθὼν δι’ ὕδατος καὶ αἵματος Ἰησοῦς Χριστός οὐκ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι μόνον ἀλλ’ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ ἐν τῷ αἵματι καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν ὅτι τὸ Πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἡ ἀλήθεια

passages.text: For there are three that testify: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
passages.sermon:
Three give testimony.
The Spirit gives testimony.
The water gives testimony.
The blood gives testimony.
These three agree as one.
passages.original: ὅτι τρεῖς εἰσιν οἱ μαρτυροῦντες τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸ αἷμα καὶ οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὸ ἕν εἰσιν

passages.text: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
passages.sermon:
God gives testimony about His Son.
God’s testimony is greater than any human testimony.
People may accept testimony from other people.
But God’s testimony is more important.
God has given this testimony about His Son.
passages.original: Εἰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαμβάνομεν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Θεοῦ μείζων ἐστίν ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
passages.sermon:
The Son of God is Jesus.
God has given testimony about His Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony inside himself.
Whoever does not believe God calls God a liar.
He does this because he does not believe the testimony God has given about His Son.
passages.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔχει τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐν αὑτῷ ὁ μὴ πιστεύων τῷ Θεῷ ψεύστην πεποίηκεν αὐτόν ὅτι οὐ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν μεμαρτύρηκεν ὁ Θεὸς περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
passages.sermon:
God has given us a testimony.
This testimony is clear.
God has given us eternal life.
This eternal life is in His Son.
passages.original: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία ὅτι ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῖν καὶ αὕτη ἡ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

passages.text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
passages.sermon: The Son of God gives life.\r\nWhoever has the Son has life.\r\nWhoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
passages.original: ὁ ἔχων τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει τὴν ζωήν ὁ μὴ ἔχων τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ζωὴν οὐκ ἔχει

passages.text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
passages.sermon:
I am writing to you.
You believe in the name of the Son of God.
You trust in Jesus, who is God's Son.
I want you to know something important.
You have eternal life.
God gives this life to those who believe in His Son.
passages.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἵνα εἰδῆτε ὅτι ζωὴν ἔχετε αἰώνιον τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
passages.sermon:
We have confidence before God.
God listens to us.
We ask God for things.
We must ask according to God's will.
If we ask according to His will, God hears us.
passages.original: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ παρρησία ἣν ἔχομεν πρὸς αὐτόν ὅτι ἐάν τι αἰτώμεθα κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ἀκούει ἡμῶν

passages.text: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
passages.sermon:
God hears us when we ask Him for anything.
We know this.
If God hears us, we know something else.
We know we already have what we asked from Him.
passages.original: καὶ ἐὰν οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀκούει ἡμῶν ὃ ἐὰν αἰτώμεθα οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἔχομεν τὰ αἰτήματα ἃ ᾐτήκαμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
passages.sermon:
A brother is a fellow believer in Christ.
A sin not leading to death is a sin that does not result in spiritual death.
If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should pray to God.
God will give life to those who commit sins not leading to death.
There is a sin that leads to death.
I do not say that anyone should pray about that sin.
passages.original: Ἐάν τις ἴδῃ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτάνοντα ἁμαρτίαν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον αἰτήσει καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ ζωήν τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον ἔστιν ἁμαρτία πρὸς θάνατον οὐ περὶ ἐκείνης λέγω ἵνα ἐρωτήσῃ

passages.text: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
passages.sermon: Unrighteousness is sin.\r\nSome sin does not lead to death.
passages.original: πᾶσα ἀδικία ἁμαρτία ἐστίν καὶ ἔστιν ἁμαρτία οὐ πρὸς θάνατον

passages.text: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
passages.sermon:
Anyone born of God is a Christian.
A Christian does not keep on sinning.
Jesus was born of God.
Jesus protects the Christian.
The evil one cannot touch the Christian.
passages.original: Οἴδαμεν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει ἀλλ’ ὁ γεννηθεὶς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τηρεῖ αὐτόν καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς οὐχ ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ

passages.text: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
passages.sermon: We know that we belong to God.\r\nThe whole world lies under the power of the evil one.
passages.original: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐσμεν καὶ ὁ κόσμος ὅλος ἐν τῷ πονηρῷ κεῖται

passages.text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
passages.sermon:
The Son of God is Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ has come.
He has given us understanding.
He did this so we may know the true God.
We are in the true God.
We are in His Son, Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ is the true God.
Jesus Christ is eternal life.
passages.original: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἥκει καὶ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν διάνοιαν ἵνα γινώσκωμεν τὸν ἀληθινόν καὶ ἐσμὲν ἐν τῷ ἀληθινῷ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀληθινὸς Θεὸς καὶ ζωὴ αἰώνιος

passages.text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
passages.sermon:
John speaks to believers.
He calls them little children.
He tells them to keep themselves from idols.
He warns them to avoid false gods.
passages.original: Τεκνία φυλάξατε ἑαυτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων
